_about: Enforced triangle budgets per asset kind and LOD, and the LOD switch distances (metres at lodBias 1; the PC quality level uses lodBias 2, which doubles them). The Blender build and the Unity tests both read this file. Decision LP2.

chair._about: Up close raised from 800 to 1,600 (the owner, 2026-09-29) so the grips can be modelled: only chairs within the first switch distance use it; the far levels, which most chairs on a line use, are unchanged.

snowgun._about: Hundreds of snow guns on a mountain: a few hundred triangles up close, switching early; far out the lance is one bar. The lance is the only moving part (LOD0-2).

tower_head._about: Many towers per lift and 16 round sheaves on the heaviest heads: switching earlier than terminals keeps a whole line of 20 towers near 30k triangles in view; sheaves spin only at LOD0.
